facts.value: Hua Yuan, Flower Garden, a maze

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: Looted and burnt 1860; stone ruins stayed, further damage 1900 and after (S02 pp.142,218)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Copper engraving no. 5 per S02. Engraving calls it 花园. Also 万花阵 (S06; S42). S06 89 x 59 m; walls 1.2 m high. S06 wall length 16 km looks wrong, check on plan. Rebuilt in modern times (S06).
